source_title: H3C MSR Comware 7 Command Reference R0615
source_section: display ospf peer > Examples > Display brief OSPF neighbor information (lines 10370-10386)
source_note: The official Comware 7 command reference shows State before Interface, one regular neighbor, and a sham-link neighbor table without an Interface column. The parser emits the sham-link neighbor with an empty INTERFACE value; the reference release does not confirm the running device build.
